pois.name: Myeongdong
pois.description: Energetic shopping and street food district. Giant ice creams, character cotton candy, Korean snacks.

pois.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
pois.description: Grand Joseon dynasty palace with changing of the guard ceremony. Hanbok rental available.

pois.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
pois.description: Hillside neighbourhood of traditional Korean houses between two palaces.

pois.name: Insadong
pois.description: Art and antiques district with galleries, traditional tea houses, and craft shops.

pois.name: Lotte World
pois.description: Massive indoor and outdoor theme park in Jamsil. Great rainy day option.

pois.name: Dongdaemun Design Plaza
pois.description: Zaha Hadid-designed futuristic landmark with exhibitions, shops, and night market nearby.

pois.name: COEX Mall & Starfield Library
pois.description: Massive underground mall with the stunning open Starfield Library at its centre.

pois.name: Bongeunsa Temple
pois.description: Peaceful 8th-century Buddhist temple hidden in the heart of Gangnam.

pois.name: Garosu-gil
pois.description: Tree-lined street in Sinsa-dong with trendy cafes, boutiques, and galleries.

pois.name: Han River Park
pois.description: Riverside parks perfect for picnics, cycling, and watching Banpo Bridge fountain show.

pois.name: Banpo Bridge Rainbow Fountain
pois.description: World's longest bridge fountain. Rainbow light show on seasonal evenings.

pois.name: N Seoul Tower (Namsan)
pois.description: Iconic tower on Namsan mountain. Cable car up, walk down. Love lock fence at the top.

pois.name: Itaewon
pois.description: International neighbourhood with diverse food, vintage shops, and lively nightlife.

pois.name: Hongdae
pois.description: University district with street performances, indie shops, and vibrant nightlife.
